<?php
$login = $_POST["login"];
$password = $_POST["password"];
$nom = $_POST["nom"];
$prenom = $_POST["prenom"];

$cnx = mysqli_connect("127.0.0.1", "root", "", "bd_20252026");

$sql = "insert into users values('$login','$password','$nom','$prenom');";

if (mysqli_query($cnx, $sql)) {
    echo "inscription valid";
} else {
    echo "utilisateur existant";
}

mysqli_close($cnx);
?>
